name: osm-mcp-server
description: MCP server for OpenStreetMap: geocoding, reverse geocoding, routing, POI search via Nominatim, OSRM and Overpass

scripts.smoke: node -e "const {spawn}=require('child_process');const p=spawn('node',['index.js'],{stdio:['pipe','pipe','inherit']});let b='';p.stdout.on('data',d=>{b+=d;const lines=b.split('\n');for(const l of lines){if(!l.trim())continue;try{const m=JSON.parse(l);if(m.id===1){console.log('TOOLS:',m.result.tools.map(t=>t.name).join(', '));p.kill();process.exit(0)}}catch{}}});p.stdin.write(JSON.stringify({jsonrpc:'2.0',id:1,method:'tools/list',params:{}})+'\n');setTimeout(()=>{console.error('timeout');p.kill();process.exit(1)},15000);"
